    "prose": [
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "As the transverse wave travels, once the vibration has reached the thirteenth ball, the first and thirteenth balls undergo identical vibrations.\n\nWhen the first ball is at its equilibrium position and moving left (see Figure 70e), the thirteenth ball is also at equilibrium and moving left.\n\nAfter another $\\frac{1}{4}$ of a period, the first ball reaches its maximum displacement to the left, and the thirteenth ball reaches the same position (see Figure 70f).\n\nThe two balls always vibrate in the same phase.\n**The distance between the nearest points vibrating in the same phase is called the wavelength**.\n\nThus the distances from the first ball to the thirteenth, from the second to the fourteenth, and from the third to the fifteenth all equal one wavelength (see Figures 70e and 70f).",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 100,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0110#4"
        ],
        "source_text": "在横波传播时，当振动传到了第十三个球后，第一个和第十三个球将作完全相同的振动。当第一个球在平衡位置上并向左运动时（见图70д），第十三个球也在平衡位置，并且也向左运动。又过了$\\frac{1}{4}$周期，第一个球向左运动到最大偏移位置，第十三个球同样也到达这样的位置（见图70е）。这两个球的振动相位总是相同的。**相距最近的振动相位相同的两个点间的距离叫做波长。**所以，第一个球和第十三个球之间的距离，第二个球和第十四个球之间的距离，第三个球和第十五个球之间的距离都等于波长（见图70д、е）。",

        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": [],

          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "For the longitudinal wave in Figure 71b, the wavelength equals the distance between the second and fourteenth balls, or between the fourth and sixteenth balls.\n\nWavelength is denoted by the Greek letter $\\lambda$.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 100,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0110#5"
        ],
        "source_text": "相应于图71б所示的纵波的波长等于第二个球与第十四个球之间的距离，或第四个球与第十六个球之间的距离。波长用希腊字母$\\lambda$表示。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",

        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": [],
        "figures": [

            "id": "fig-71",
            "label": "图 71"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "As a wave travels, different points in the medium, such as the balls in this model, vibrate in different phases unless their separation equals $n\\lambda$ ($n$ is an integer).\n\nThe first and seventh balls, separated by $\\lambda/2$ (see Figure 70), vibrate in opposite phases: when the first ball moves left, the seventh moves right, and vice versa.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 100,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0110#6",
          "p0111#1"
        ],
        "source_text": "在波传播的时候，物体的不同的点（如在所观察的模型上的各球），只要它们之间的距离不等于$n\\lambda$（$n$为整数），就各以不同的相位振动。相距为$\\lambda/2$的第一个球和第七个球（见图70）以相反的相位振动：当第一个球向左运动时，第七个球就向右移动，反过来也是这样。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",

        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "In one period, a wave travels a distance $\\lambda$ (see Figure 70e).\nIts speed is therefore given by\n$v=\\frac{\\lambda}{T}$ (4.1)\n\nSince the period $T$ and frequency $\\nu$ are related by\n$T=\\frac{1}{\\nu}$,\nit follows that\n\n$v=\\lambda\\nu$ (4.2)",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 101,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0111#2"
        ],
        "source_text": "在一个周期之内波传播的距离为$\\lambda$（见图70д）。所以波的速度可用下面公式求出：$v=\\frac{\\lambda}{T}$　(4.1)因为周期$T$和频率$\\nu$的相互关系为$T=\\frac{1}{\\nu}$，所以　$v=\\lambda\\nu$　(4.2)",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "**Wave speed equals wavelength multiplied by the vibration frequency**.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 101,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0111#3"
        ],
        "source_text": "**波的速度等于波长和振动频率的乘积。**",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "When a wave travels along a string, we can observe two kinds of periodicity.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 101,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0111#4"
        ],
        "source_text": "当波在绳中传播时，我们就遇到了两种类型的周期性。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "First, each point on the string vibrates periodically in time.\n\nFor harmonic vibrations, which follow a sine or cosine law, all the points have the same frequency and amplitude and differ only in phase.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 101,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0111#5"
        ],
        "source_text": "第一，绳的每一个质点都随时间作周期性的振动。在谐振动的情况下（这些振动是按正弦或余弦规律进行的），所有的质点的频率和振幅都是相同的，振动的区别仅仅在于相位。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "Second, at any instant, the shape of the wave repeats along the string at intervals of $\\lambda$.\nThe curve through $O$ in Figure 72 shows the wave's shape at one instant.\n\nAs time passes, the entire shape moves from left to right at speed $v$.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 101,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0111#6"
        ],
        "source_text": "第二，任一时刻在空间中，每隔一段长为$\\lambda$的绳，就出现重复的波形。图72所示的就是某一时刻的波形（过$O$点的曲线）。随着时间的推移，整个图形从左向右以速度$v$移动。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "fig",
        "text": "",

        "label": "图 72",

          "p0111#7"
        ],
        "source_text": "",

        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "cap",
        "text": "Figure 72",
        "id": null,
        "label": "图 72",
        "printed_page": 101,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0111#8"
        ],
        "source_text": "图72",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",

        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",
        "text": "After a time interval\n$\\Delta t=\\frac{\\Delta s}{v}$\nthe wave has the shape shown by the curve that does not pass through $O$.",
        "id": null,
        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 101,
        "source_refs": [
          "p0111#9",
          "p0112#1"
        ],
        "source_text": "经过一段时间$\\Delta t=\\frac{\\Delta s}{v}$波将具有图中不过$O$点的曲线所示的形式。",
        "changes": [
          "translation",
          "wording",
          "layout"
        ],
        "numeric_changes": [],
        "historical_entities": []
      },
      {
        "kind": "p",

        "label": null,
        "printed_page": 102,
